info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Reminders-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Reminders API provides access to utility billing reminders for customers, facilitating timely notifications regarding upcoming deadlines. This API enables consumers to retrieve a list of reminders associated with their accounts, ensuring they stay informed about payment schedules. Typical users include utility companies and their clients seeking to streamline communication about billing cycles. Integration of this API helps enhance customer experience and encourages prompt payments.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve details about their billing reminders, including the amount due and the due date. It is useful for users to keep track of upcoming payments and ensure timely transactions.

requestBody.description: This request is used to retrieve billing reminder information. Please provide the required parameters in the request body to ensure the correct reminder details are returned.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for the GET operation regarding billing reminders.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_200.title: Billing Reminder Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the billing reminder.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the request.

ListUtilityBillingRemindersResponse_200.description: Response object for the Billing Reminder GET operation, containing status information and processing details.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information
